subject.title: feat: bound raw transcript reads across replacements

question: Should OpenClaw permanently own the v12 durable transcript-generation migration and the public `readSessionTranscriptRawDelta` cursor/reset API now, or should this remain an internal active-memory optimization until the plugin contract has a sponsored design?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent and has focused evidence, but the repository policy reserves SQLite schema-version advances and durable Plugin SDK surface direction for explicit human acceptance.

options.title: Approve the durable foundation
options.body: Accept schema v12 and the Plugin SDK cursor/reset semantics as supported long-term contracts, then require a rebase and upgrade/fresh-install verification on the exact merge head.

options.title: Keep the reader internal
options.body: Retain bounded active-memory reads but remove the public SDK surface and avoid a durable migration until a concrete external plugin caller warrants the contract.

options.title: Pause for a narrow API proposal
options.body: Hold this PR while the cursor ownership, reset semantics, and external-plugin compatibility expectations are reviewed separately.

recommendation.title: Approve the durable foundation
recommendation.body: Accept schema v12 and the Plugin SDK cursor/reset semantics as supported long-term contracts, then require a rebase and upgrade/fresh-install verification on the exact merge head.

likelyOwner.reason: They implemented the proposed sessions, database, and SDK design and can provide its intended contract details; an explicit repository owner must make the final acceptance decision.
